name: Undertow
subtitle: Your own music server, on your iPhone

apps.name: Undertow
apps.subtitle: Music player for your Undertow server
apps.localizedDescription: Plays the music of your own Undertow server, in the background and on the lock screen. On first start, type your server's address and, with MTLS, import this phone's certificate.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Undertow connects to your music server on your network.
